# Municipal Ordinance No. 004, Series of 2008

**An Ordinance Creating the Position of Private Secretary 1 in the Office of the Municipal Mayor in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon**

## Summary

This ordinance creates the position of Private Secretary 1 in the Office of the Municipal Mayor of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], Quezon. The position is assigned salary grade 11 in the plantilla of personnel schedule. The ordinance specifies the functions, duties, and responsibilities of the position and provides that the corresponding appropriation shall be included in the Supplemental Budget for CY 2008.

## Key Provisions

**Section 1 — Creation of Position.** The position of Private Secretary 1 is hereby created in the Office of the Municipal Mayor of Pitogo, Quezon, with salary grade 11 in the plantilla of personnel schedule.

**Section 2 — Functions, Duties and Responsibilities.**
1. Maintain all programs/programs of the agency
2. Accompany the Municipal Mayor in meetings with the barangays
3. Liaison duties
4. Liaise with the different provincial offices relative to development projects of the agency

**Section 3 — Appropriation.** The corresponding appropriation for the said position shall be included in the Supplemental Budget for CY 2008.

**Section 4 — Effectivity.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon its approval.

**Section 5 — Approval.** Approved by the Sangguniang Bayan of Pitogo, Quezon on the 12th day of May 2008.
